samples.title: Choosing the right equation of motion
samples.subject: Physical Sciences
samples.script: A car accelerates uniformly from ten metres per second to twenty-five metres per second over three hundred metres. Which equation? List what you have: initial velocity, final velocity, displacement - and no time. So select v f squared equals v i squared plus two a delta x, the only equation on your data sheet without time in it. Substitute explicitly, solve for a: zero comma eight seven five metres per second squared. Units stated, correctly rounded. That substitution line is where the mark sheet pays you.
